notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V2.10 (Robot Puppy, Home, Whiteboard and more)
notes.content:
Version 2.10 is Live. Get it now! (If you have older version you can't play with players who has this new version, make sure you have this update)

Features and fixes;

* 'Companion' is added to menu. We have a robot puppy for everyone :) You can call him anytime with selecting companion icon. Click again to send him back. He is fun and interactive. We will advance his AI and give you some crazy options for your companion. Also later on we will have a lot of different companion options. 

* 'Home' Location is added. This is our landing location from now on! You can still go any other location from menu. We will have some important changes on Home location later on. 

* 'Whiteboard' Location is added. You can draw anything and save/embed your drawings to this location. This is like an open whiteboard for all users to share their creation. We will periodically clean up some existing drawings or open all new whiteboard.

* Palette options for brush. Now when you chose brush on other controller you will see a palette with some options. You can change brush type, save and load drawings. If you click save, everything you draw on that scene will be saved, which you can load anytime you want. Save option is location specific for now.

* You can change color and size of the brush with touchpad on controller.

* Improvements on location user count information.

* Improvements on brush.

* Some hidden secrets.


Next update, coming soon;

* 'Life' features for drawings
* New brush features
* Gender change
* User profile and related features
* Mobile support

notes.title: v2.07b update - OCULUS SUPPORT !
notes.content:
Version 2.07b is Live with OCULUS SUPPORT!

Now SurrealVR is crossplatform on Vive, Oculus and PC flatscreen! 

There might be bugs in some functionality for Oculus, please take it easy on us and report problems if you see any :) Oculus users can use keyboard and mouse OR game controller. We will fix things and add more stuff for all platforms. Meantime we are working on;

- OSVR, Mobile touchscreen and Cardboard support. 
- Improving IK
- Generic Hub place to meet up instead of random places in SurrealVR
- More functionality for brush (PC and Oculus brush also wip)

Thanks for your support :) 

SurrealVR Team

notes.title: Version 2.05: PC nonVR flatscreen support and navigation options for Vive!
notes.content:
Version 2.05. Get it Now! (If you don't get this update you won't see new players. Make sure you are up to date)

Features and fixes;

* PC nonVR support! You can use keyboard, mouse and controller for PC nonVR. (Oculus full support will come very soon)
* Navigation options for Vive! (In menu you can pick teleport or move)
* PC Moving: WASD or Left Analog
* PC Rotate: Mouse or Right Analog
* PC Menu: M key or B button
* PC Throw: Space key or A button (You can hold and release for longer distances)
* PC Camera change: C key or Y button
* PC Changing objects quickly: Mouse scroll or R and L bumpers
* PC Flashlight: L key or X button
* PC Drone up/down: Q and E keys or R and L triggers
* PC If you open the menu with M then press K to see all key mapping.

Next update coming soon;

* Oculus Support!
* More Surprises
